taskDescription: Verify user can navigate to Keyword Manager module from Configuration menu
acceptanceCriteria: User should successfully land on Keyword Manager listing page
preconditions: User logged into AML application with valid access
testSteps:
1. Login to AML application
2. Navigate to Configuration menu
3. Click Screening – Keyword Configuration
expectedResult: Keyword Manager listing page loads successfully with Active, Inactive, and Drafted tabs displayed

taskDescription: Verify Keyword Manager page title and breadcrumb display correctly
acceptanceCriteria: Page title and breadcrumb should match specification
testSteps:
1. Navigate to Configuration > Screening – Keyword Configuration
2. Observe page header and breadcrumb
expectedResult: Breadcrumb should display 'Configuration > Screening – Keyword Configuration' and page title should be correct

taskDescription: Verify Active tab is selected by default on page load
acceptanceCriteria: Active tab should be highlighted as default
testSteps:
1. Open Keyword Manager page
2. Observe default tab selection
expectedResult: Active tab should be selected by default and display active keyword entries

taskDescription: Verify Active, Inactive, and Drafted tabs are all visible on listing page
acceptanceCriteria: All three tabs should be displayed in tab bar
testSteps:
1. Open Keyword Manager page
2. Observe tab bar
expectedResult: Active, Inactive, and Drafted tabs should all be visible with entry counts

taskDescription: Verify entry counts displayed in each tab are accurate
acceptanceCriteria: Tab counts should reflect actual number of entries per status
preconditions: User on Keyword Manager page with known dataset
testSteps:
1. Open Keyword Manager page
2. Observe count shown on each tab
3. Compare with actual record counts
expectedResult: Count displayed on each tab should match actual keyword entries for that status

taskDescription: Verify page remains stable during initial data load for large keyword datasets
acceptanceCriteria: Page should remain responsive during initial load
testSteps:
1. Open Keyword Manager page with large dataset
2. Observe page loading behaviour
expectedResult: Page should load without freeze, crash, or timeout

taskDescription: Verify empty state is displayed when no keyword entries exist
acceptanceCriteria: Proper empty state message should appear
testSteps: 1. Open Keyword Manager page with empty dataset
expectedResult: System should display a proper no-records-found empty state message without errors

taskDescription: Verify action bar buttons are visible on Keyword Manager listing page
acceptanceCriteria: Add Keyword, Add Category, Category Controls, Bulk Import, Export buttons should be visible
testSteps:
1. Open Keyword Manager page
2. Observe toolbar/action bar
expectedResult: All configured action buttons should be visible in the action bar

taskDescription: Verify clicking Inactive tab loads inactive keyword entries
acceptanceCriteria: Inactive entries should display after clicking Inactive tab
preconditions: User on Keyword Manager page with inactive keywords
testSteps:
1. Click the Inactive tab
2. Observe results
expectedResult: Inactive tab should load and display only inactive keyword entries

taskDescription: Verify clicking Drafted tab loads drafted keyword entries
acceptanceCriteria: Drafted entries should display after clicking Drafted tab
preconditions: User on Keyword Manager page with drafted keywords
testSteps:
1. Click the Drafted tab
2. Observe results
expectedResult: Drafted tab should load and display only drafted keyword entries

taskDescription: Verify switching between tabs does not lose data or cause errors
acceptanceCriteria: Tab switching should be stable and data consistent
testSteps:
1. Click Active tab
2. Click Inactive tab
3. Click Drafted tab
4. Return to Active tab
expectedResult: Tab switching should be smooth; data should reload correctly without errors

taskDescription: Verify table headers are consistent across all tabs
acceptanceCriteria: Same column headers should appear on all tabs
testSteps:
1. Open Active tab and note headers
2. Click Inactive and note headers
3. Click Drafted and note headers
expectedResult: Column headers should be identical across Active, Inactive, and Drafted tabs

taskDescription: Verify keyword listing table displays all configured columns
acceptanceCriteria: Table should show all defined columns
preconditions: User on Keyword Manager Active tab
testSteps:
1. Open Keyword Manager page
2. Observe table column headers
expectedResult: Table should display Keyword/Phrase, Category, Risk Level, Match Type, Threshold Score, Status, and Actions columns

taskDescription: Verify Keyword/Phrase column displays correct values
acceptanceCriteria: Keyword values should match stored entries
testSteps:
1. Open listing page
2. Cross-check Keyword column values
expectedResult: Correct keyword/phrase values should be displayed for each entry

taskDescription: Verify Category column displays correct category assignment per keyword
acceptanceCriteria: Category names should match each keyword's configured category
testSteps:
1. Open listing
2. Verify Category values
expectedResult: Each keyword should show its correctly assigned category

taskDescription: Verify Risk Level column displays correct risk badge for each keyword
acceptanceCriteria: Risk badges (Low/Medium/High) should be accurately displayed
preconditions: Keyword entries with all risk levels available
testSteps:
1. Open listing
2. Observe Risk Level column for Low, Medium, High values
expectedResult: Low, Medium, High badges should display with correct styling for each entry

taskDescription: Verify Match Type column correctly identifies Exact Match and Fuzzy Match entries
acceptanceCriteria: Match Type should be accurate per entry
preconditions: Dataset with both Exact and Fuzzy entries
testSteps:
1. Open listing
2. Review Match Type column for multiple rows
expectedResult: Exact Match and Fuzzy Match values should display correctly per entry

taskDescription: Verify Threshold Score column is populated for Fuzzy Match entries
acceptanceCriteria: Threshold Score should be shown for Fuzzy Match rows
testSteps:
1. Open listing
2. Check Threshold Score column for Fuzzy Match rows
expectedResult: Threshold Score (1-100) should be displayed for Fuzzy Match entries

taskDescription: Verify Threshold Score column is blank or N/A for Exact Match entries
acceptanceCriteria: Exact Match entries should not show a Threshold Score
testSteps:
1. Open listing
2. Check Threshold Score column for Exact Match rows
expectedResult: Threshold Score column should be empty or N/A for Exact Match entries

taskDescription: Verify Status column displays correct status for each entry
acceptanceCriteria: Status badges (Active, Inactive, Draft, Pending Approval) should be accurate
testSteps:
1. Open listing
2. Review Status column values
expectedResult: Correct status badges should display for each keyword entry

taskDescription: Verify long keyword phrases do not break table layout
acceptanceCriteria: Long text should not cause layout distortion
testSteps:
1. Open listing with long keyword phrases
2. Observe table rendering
expectedResult: Long keyword phrases should render without breaking table alignment

taskDescription: Verify table supports vertical scrolling for large datasets
acceptanceCriteria: Table should be scrollable when records exceed viewport height
testSteps:
1. Open listing with many records
2. Scroll table vertically
expectedResult: Table should scroll smoothly without layout issues

taskDescription: Verify search field is visible in toolbar on keyword listing page
acceptanceCriteria: Search input should be present in toolbar
testSteps:
1. Open Keyword Manager page
2. Observe toolbar area
expectedResult: Search input field should be visible with placeholder text

taskDescription: Verify search returns matching records when valid keyword is entered
acceptanceCriteria: Search should return entries matching the typed text
testSteps:
1. Enter known keyword phrase in search field
2. Observe filtered results
expectedResult: Only records matching the search text should be displayed

taskDescription: Verify search is case-insensitive
acceptanceCriteria: Same results should appear regardless of case used
testSteps:
1. Search using lowercase text
2. Search using uppercase text
3. Compare results
expectedResult: Search results should be identical regardless of case input

taskDescription: Verify search returns no results for unmatched text
acceptanceCriteria: System should show empty state for unmatched search
testSteps:
1. Enter text that does not match any keyword
2. Observe results
expectedResult: No records found message should display without errors

taskDescription: Verify clearing search field restores full keyword listing
acceptanceCriteria: Clearing the search should show all records again
preconditions: Search is currently active with filtered results
testSteps:
1. Apply a search filter
2. Clear the search field
3. Observe results
expectedResult: Full keyword listing should be restored after clearing search

taskDescription: Verify special characters are handled safely in search field
acceptanceCriteria: System should not crash or error on special character input
testSteps:
1. Enter special characters in search field
2. Observe behaviour
expectedResult: System should handle special character input without crash or API error

taskDescription: Verify Add Category modal opens when Add Category button is clicked
acceptanceCriteria: Modal should appear as overlay on clicking Add Category
testSteps:
1. Click Add Category button in toolbar
2. Observe modal behaviour
expectedResult: 'Create a new Keyword screening category' modal should open as overlay

taskDescription: Verify Category Name field is mandatory in Add Category modal
acceptanceCriteria: Submission should be blocked if Category Name is empty
testSteps:
1. Leave Category Name blank
2. Click Add Category button
expectedResult: Inline validation error should appear and modal should not close

taskDescription: Verify Category Name accepts valid input up to 100 characters
acceptanceCriteria: Category Name field should accept up to 100 characters
testSteps:
1. Enter a category name of exactly 100 characters
2. Submit form
expectedResult: Category name should be accepted and submitted successfully

taskDescription: Verify Category Name beyond 100 characters is rejected
acceptanceCriteria: Field should enforce 100-character limit
testSteps:
1. Enter a name exceeding 100 characters
2. Submit
expectedResult: System should restrict input or display validation error for names over 100 characters

taskDescription: Verify duplicate Category Name is rejected with inline error
acceptanceCriteria: Duplicate category names should not be allowed
testSteps:
1. Enter category name 'ML_TF'
2. Submit
expectedResult: Inline error should appear stating the name already exists and form should not submit

taskDescription: Verify Category Description field is optional
acceptanceCriteria: Category should be created successfully without description
testSteps:
1. Enter Category Name only
2. Leave description blank
3. Submit
expectedResult: Category should be submitted successfully without a description

taskDescription: Verify Category Description accepts up to 500 characters
acceptanceCriteria: Description field should allow up to 500 characters
testSteps:
1. Enter 500-character description
2. Submit
expectedResult: Description should be accepted within the 500 character limit

taskDescription: Verify Category Description beyond 500 characters is restricted
acceptanceCriteria: Field should not accept more than 500 characters
testSteps: 1. Enter description exceeding 500 characters
expectedResult: System should restrict input or show error for description over 500 characters

taskDescription: Verify successful Add Category submission sends entry for Checker approval
acceptanceCriteria: New category should enter Pending Approval state
preconditions: User is Maker with valid inputs
testSteps:
1. Enter valid Category Name and Description
2. Click Add Category
expectedResult: Modal closes, category enters Pending Approval, audit log entry is created

taskDescription: Verify Cancel button on Add Category modal discards data without saving
acceptanceCriteria: Modal should close and no category should be created
preconditions: Add Category modal is open with data entered
testSteps:
1. Enter category name
2. Click Cancel
expectedResult: Modal should close without saving; no new category should appear in the system

taskDescription: Verify confirmation prompt appears when cancelling Add Category with populated fields
acceptanceCriteria: System should warn user before discarding entered data
preconditions: Add Category modal is open with data entered
testSteps:
1. Enter category name
2. Click Cancel
3. Observe behaviour
expectedResult: Confirmation prompt should appear asking user to confirm discarding data

taskDescription: Verify Add Category modal close button works correctly
acceptanceCriteria: Modal should close on clicking X button
testSteps: 1. Click the X/close button on modal
expectedResult: Modal should close without saving

taskDescription: Verify Category Controls panel opens when Category Controls button is clicked
acceptanceCriteria: Panel should open listing all existing categories
testSteps: 1. Click Category Controls button in toolbar
expectedResult: Category Controls modal/panel should open showing all categories with enable/disable toggles

taskDescription: Verify all existing categories are listed in Category Controls panel
acceptanceCriteria: Every configured category should appear in the panel
testSteps:
1. Open Category Controls panel
2. Count listed categories
expectedResult: All configured categories should be listed in Category Controls panel

taskDescription: Verify enabled category toggle shows correct active state
acceptanceCriteria: Active categories should show enabled toggle state
testSteps:
1. Open Category Controls
2. Observe toggle state for active category
expectedResult: Enabled category should show toggle in ON/active position

taskDescription: Verify user can disable an active category using the toggle
acceptanceCriteria: Toggling off should disable the category and all its keywords
testSteps:
1. Open Category Controls
2. Toggle an active category to disabled
3. Save changes
expectedResult: Category should be submitted for Maker-Checker approval to disable

taskDescription: Verify user can re-enable a disabled category using the toggle
acceptanceCriteria: Toggle should re-enable disabled category and its keywords
testSteps:
1. Open Category Controls
2. Toggle a disabled category to enabled
3. Save changes
expectedResult: Re-enabling request should be submitted for Maker-Checker approval

taskDescription: Verify disabling a category removes all its keywords from active screening
acceptanceCriteria: Keywords under disabled category should stop being evaluated
testSteps:
1. Disable category
2. Verify keywords in that category become inactive in screening
expectedResult: All keywords under the disabled category should cease to be evaluated at next screening run

taskDescription: Verify Cancel button on Category Controls panel discards unsaved changes
acceptanceCriteria: Closing without saving should not modify categories
preconditions: Category Controls panel is open with unsaved toggle changes
testSteps:
1. Toggle a category state
2. Click Cancel
3. Reopen panel
expectedResult: Original category states should be retained; no changes should be saved

taskDescription: Verify category controls changes are subject to Maker-Checker approval
acceptanceCriteria: Changes should not take effect until approved by Checker
testSteps:
1. Toggle a category
2. Save changes
3. Observe system state
expectedResult: Changes should enter Pending Approval state and require Checker approval before taking effect

taskDescription: Verify Add Keyword panel opens when Add Keyword button is clicked
acceptanceCriteria: Add New Keyword panel should open
testSteps: 1. Click Add Keyword button in toolbar
expectedResult: Add New Keyword panel should open as a right-side panel or modal

taskDescription: Verify Keyword/Phrase field is mandatory
acceptanceCriteria: Form should not submit without a keyword value
testSteps:
1. Leave Keyword/Phrase blank
2. Click Submit
expectedResult: Inline validation error should display and submission should be blocked

taskDescription: Verify Keyword/Phrase field accepts up to 500 characters
acceptanceCriteria: Field should support up to 500 characters
testSteps:
1. Enter exactly 500-character keyword phrase
2. Submit
expectedResult: Input should be accepted and submitted successfully

taskDescription: Verify Keyword/Phrase field beyond 500 characters is restricted
acceptanceCriteria: Field should enforce 500-character limit
testSteps: 1. Enter more than 500 characters
expectedResult: System should restrict or show validation error for phrases exceeding 500 characters

taskDescription: Verify Category dropdown is mandatory and lists only active categories
acceptanceCriteria: Category must be selected from active categories
testSteps:
1. Open Category dropdown
2. Observe listed categories
3. Try to submit without selecting
expectedResult: Only active categories should be listed; submission should be blocked without a category selection

taskDescription: Verify Risk Level is mandatory and supports Low, Medium, and High options
acceptanceCriteria: Risk Level field must be selected
testSteps:
1. Open Risk Level dropdown
2. Observe options
3. Try to submit without selection
expectedResult: Low, Medium, High options should be available; form should block submission without a selection

taskDescription: Verify Match Type is mandatory and presents Exact Match and Fuzzy Match options
acceptanceCriteria: Match Type must be selected from the two allowed options
testSteps:
1. Open Match Type dropdown
2. Observe available options
expectedResult: Only Exact Match and Fuzzy Match options should be available

taskDescription: Verify Threshold Score field is hidden when Exact Match is selected
acceptanceCriteria: Threshold Score should not appear for Exact Match
testSteps:
1. Select Exact Match as Match Type
2. Observe Threshold Score field
expectedResult: Threshold Score field should be hidden/invisible when Exact Match is selected

taskDescription: Verify Threshold Score field appears when Fuzzy Match is selected
acceptanceCriteria: Threshold Score must appear for Fuzzy Match
testSteps:
1. Select Fuzzy Match as Match Type
2. Observe Threshold Score field
expectedResult: Threshold Score field should become visible and mandatory when Fuzzy Match is selected

taskDescription: Verify Threshold Score field is mandatory when Fuzzy Match is selected
acceptanceCriteria: Form should block submission if Fuzzy Match chosen but no Threshold Score entered
preconditions: Add Keyword panel with Fuzzy Match selected
testSteps:
1. Select Fuzzy Match
2. Leave Threshold Score blank
3. Submit
expectedResult: Inline error should block submission: Threshold Score is required for Fuzzy Match

taskDescription: Verify Threshold Score accepts values between 1 and 100 inclusive
acceptanceCriteria: Valid range is 1 to 100
preconditions: Add Keyword panel with Fuzzy Match selected
testSteps:
1. Enter Threshold Score of 1
2. Enter score of 50
3. Enter score of 100
expectedResult: All values between 1 and 100 should be accepted

taskDescription: Verify Threshold Score value below 1 is clamped to 1
acceptanceCriteria: Values below 1 should be corrected to 1
preconditions: Add Keyword panel with Fuzzy Match selected
testSteps: 1. Enter Threshold Score of 0 or negative value
expectedResult: System should clamp the value to 1 and display 1 in the field

taskDescription: Verify Threshold Score value above 100 is clamped to 100
acceptanceCriteria: Values above 100 should be corrected to 100
preconditions: Add Keyword panel with Fuzzy Match selected
testSteps: 1. Enter Threshold Score of 101 or higher
expectedResult: System should clamp the value to 100 and display 100 in the field

taskDescription: Verify live precision indicator shows 'Low precision' for Threshold Score below 50
acceptanceCriteria: Indicator should reflect Low precision for scores 1–49
preconditions: Add Keyword panel with Fuzzy Match selected
testSteps: 1. Enter Threshold Score of 30
expectedResult: Live indicator should display 'Low precision' label

taskDescription: Verify live precision indicator shows 'Balanced' for Threshold Score between 50 and 79
acceptanceCriteria: Indicator should reflect Balanced for scores 50–79
preconditions: Add Keyword panel with Fuzzy Match selected
testSteps: 1. Enter Threshold Score of 65
expectedResult: Live indicator should display 'Balanced' label

taskDescription: Verify live precision indicator shows 'High precision' for Threshold Score of 80 or above
acceptanceCriteria: Indicator should reflect High precision for scores 80–100
preconditions: Add Keyword panel with Fuzzy Match selected
testSteps: 1. Enter Threshold Score of 85
expectedResult: Live indicator should display 'High precision' label

taskDescription: Verify Threshold Score boundary 50 displays 'Balanced' precision
acceptanceCriteria: Score of exactly 50 should show Balanced
preconditions: Add Keyword panel with Fuzzy Match selected
testSteps: 1. Enter Threshold Score of 50
expectedResult: Live indicator should display 'Balanced' for score of exactly 50

taskDescription: Verify Threshold Score boundary 80 displays 'High precision'
acceptanceCriteria: Score of exactly 80 should show High precision
preconditions: Add Keyword panel with Fuzzy Match selected
testSteps: 1. Enter Threshold Score of 80
expectedResult: Live indicator should display 'High precision' for score of exactly 80

taskDescription: Verify Threshold Score boundary 49 displays 'Low precision'
acceptanceCriteria: Score of exactly 49 should show Low precision
preconditions: Add Keyword panel with Fuzzy Match selected
testSteps: 1. Enter Threshold Score of 49
expectedResult: Live indicator should display 'Low precision' for score of exactly 49

taskDescription: Verify Screening Fields selector is mandatory with at least one field required
acceptanceCriteria: Form should block submission without any Screening Fields selected
testSteps:
1. Leave Screening Fields unselected
2. Submit
expectedResult: Inline validation error should block submission: at least one Screening Field must be selected

taskDescription: Verify Screening Fields displays three groups: Name Screening, Adverse Media Screening, KYC/Onboarding Screening
acceptanceCriteria: All three groups should be present in the multi-select control
testSteps:
1. Open Screening Fields selector
2. Observe available groups
expectedResult: Three field groups should be visible: Name Screening, Adverse Media Screening, KYC/Onboarding Screening

taskDescription: Verify Name Screening group contains all 7 configured fields
acceptanceCriteria: All 7 Name Screening fields should be selectable
preconditions: Add Keyword panel, Screening Fields open
testSteps:
1. Expand Name Screening group
2. Count available fields
expectedResult: 7 fields should be present: Business/Entity Name Suffix; Business Type/Industry Code; Occupation/Designation; Registered Address; Entity Description; Relationship Manager Notes; Beneficial Owner Description

taskDescription: Verify Adverse Media Screening group contains all 7 configured fields
acceptanceCriteria: All 7 Adverse Media fields should be selectable
preconditions: Add Keyword panel, Screening Fields open
testSteps:
1. Expand Adverse Media Screening group
2. Count available fields
expectedResult: 7 fields should be present: News Article Full Text; Article Headline; Source/Publication Category; Associated Entity Names; Country/Jurisdiction Tags; Regulatory Body Name; Crime Type Tags

taskDescription: Verify KYC/Onboarding Screening group contains all 6 configured fields
acceptanceCriteria: All 6 KYC fields should be selectable
preconditions: Add Keyword panel, Screening Fields open
testSteps:
1. Expand KYC/Onboarding Screening group
2. Count available fields
expectedResult: 6 fields should be present: Purpose of Account/Relationship; Source of Funds Description; Source of Wealth Description; Business Activity Description; Expected Transaction Description; Supporting Document Text (OCR)

taskDescription: Verify user can select a single Screening Field
acceptanceCriteria: Single field selection should be supported
preconditions: Add Keyword panel, Screening Fields open
testSteps: 1. Select one field from any group
expectedResult: Selected field should appear as a chip in the selector

taskDescription: Verify user can select multiple Screening Fields across different groups
acceptanceCriteria: Cross-group multi-selection should be supported
preconditions: Add Keyword panel, Screening Fields open
testSteps:
1. Select one field from Name Screening
2. Select one field from Adverse Media
3. Observe selections
expectedResult: Both fields should remain selected simultaneously as chips

taskDescription: Verify selected Screening Fields appear as removable chips
acceptanceCriteria: Selected fields should display as removable chip elements
preconditions: Add Keyword panel with fields selected
testSteps:
1. Select 3 screening fields
2. Observe chip display
expectedResult: Selected fields should appear as chips with remove/X icons

taskDescription: Verify removing a chip deselects that Screening Field
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking X on chip should remove that field from selection
testSteps:
1. Select multiple fields
2. Click X on one chip
3. Observe remaining selection
expectedResult: Removed field should be deselected; remaining chips should stay intact

taskDescription: Verify search box in Screening Fields selector filters available fields
acceptanceCriteria: Typing in search box should filter field list
testSteps:
1. Type 'source' in search box
2. Observe filtered results
expectedResult: Only fields containing 'source' in name should be displayed

taskDescription: Verify Save Draft saves keyword entry in Draft state
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking Save Draft should persist entry as Draft
preconditions: All mandatory fields except Screening Fields are filled
testSteps:
1. Fill in keyword details
2. Click Save Draft
expectedResult: Entry should be saved with DRAFT status and visible in the Drafted tab

taskDescription: Verify Submit sends keyword for Checker approval when all mandatory fields are valid
acceptanceCriteria: Valid submission should enter Pending Approval state
testSteps:
1. Fill all mandatory fields
2. Click Submit
expectedResult: Entry should enter Pending Approval state; Maker should be notified

taskDescription: Verify duplicate keyword entry (same keyword, match type, and category) is rejected
acceptanceCriteria: Duplicates should be blocked with inline validation
preconditions: Existing keyword 'hawala' with Fuzzy Match in ML_TF exists
testSteps:
1. Enter keyword 'hawala'
2. Select Fuzzy Match and ML_TF category
3. Submit
expectedResult: System should reject with inline message: duplicate entry already exists

taskDescription: Verify Cancel on Add Keyword panel shows confirmation prompt if fields are populated
acceptanceCriteria: Cancel should prompt user before discarding
preconditions: Add Keyword panel with data entered
testSteps:
1. Enter keyword data
2. Click Cancel
expectedResult: Confirmation prompt should appear asking user to confirm discarding data

taskDescription: Verify Cancel on Add Keyword panel with empty fields closes without prompt
acceptanceCriteria: Cancel with no data should close immediately
preconditions: Add Keyword panel with no data entered
testSteps:
1. Open Add Keyword panel
2. Click Cancel immediately
expectedResult: Panel should close immediately without a confirmation prompt

taskDescription: Verify entry remains in Pending Approval state until Checker acts
acceptanceCriteria: No auto-approval should occur
testSteps:
1. Submit keyword entry
2. Observe status without Checker action
expectedResult: Entry should remain in Pending Approval state with no status change until Checker approves or rejects

taskDescription: Verify Live Narrative Tester panel is visible in Add Keyword panel
acceptanceCriteria: Tester section should be present
testSteps:
1. Open Add Keyword panel
2. Scroll to Live Narrative Tester section
expectedResult: Live Narrative Tester section should be visible within the Add Keyword panel

taskDescription: Verify Live Narrative Tester updates preview in real time as user types keyword
acceptanceCriteria: Preview should react to keyword input
preconditions: Add Keyword panel with Tester visible
testSteps:
1. Enter keyword 'hawala'
2. Paste sample text in tester
3. Observe highlighting
expectedResult: Matching tokens in sample text should be highlighted in real time as keyword is entered

taskDescription: Verify Exact Match tester highlights only exact token matches
acceptanceCriteria: Exact Match mode should require exact token equality
testSteps:
1. Select Exact Match
2. Enter keyword 'hawala'
3. Paste text with 'hawala' and 'hwala'
4. Observe highlights
expectedResult: Only 'hawala' (exact) should be highlighted; 'hwala' should not match

taskDescription: Verify Fuzzy Match tester highlights tokens meeting or exceeding the Threshold Score
acceptanceCriteria: Fuzzy tester should respect Threshold Score
testSteps:
1. Select Fuzzy Match
2. Enter score 75
3. Paste text with near-match token
4. Observe highlights
expectedResult: Tokens with similarity ≥ 75 should be highlighted; below-threshold tokens should not be

taskDescription: Verify Tester preview does not affect live screening or create audit records
acceptanceCriteria: Tester is preview-only and should have no system-side effect
preconditions: Tester used with pasted sample text
testSteps:
1. Use Live Tester to preview matches
2. Check audit logs and screening runs
expectedResult: No audit record, alert, or screening event should be created from Tester usage

taskDescription: Verify Tester updates when Match Type is changed
acceptanceCriteria: Switching Match Type should re-evaluate the preview
preconditions: Live Tester active with sample text
testSteps:
1. Select Exact Match and observe preview
2. Switch to Fuzzy Match with score 70
3. Observe updated preview
expectedResult: Preview should update immediately when Match Type is changed

taskDescription: Verify Tester updates when Threshold Score changes
acceptanceCriteria: Changing score should update highlighted matches
preconditions: Fuzzy Match selected, sample text pasted
testSteps:
1. Set score 90 and observe
2. Change score to 50 and observe
expectedResult: Preview should update to reflect the new threshold when score is changed

taskDescription: Verify Checker can view pending keyword entries submitted by Maker
acceptanceCriteria: Checker should see Pending Approval entries
testSteps:
1. Login as Checker
2. Navigate to Keyword Manager Pending Approval queue
expectedResult: Checker should see the submitted keyword entry in Pending Approval state

taskDescription: Verify Checker can approve a pending keyword entry
acceptanceCriteria: Approval should activate the keyword entry
testSteps:
1. Checker opens pending entry
2. Clicks Approve
3. Observe status change
expectedResult: Entry should move to Active status and be applied from next screening run

taskDescription: Verify Checker can reject a pending keyword entry
acceptanceCriteria: Rejection should return entry to Draft with comments
testSteps:
1. Checker opens pending entry
2. Clicks Reject
3. Enters rejection comment
expectedResult: Entry should return to Draft state with Checker comments; Maker should be notified

taskDescription: Verify Maker cannot approve their own submitted keyword entries
acceptanceCriteria: Self-approval should be blocked
testSteps:
1. Login as Maker who submitted entry
2. Attempt to approve own submission
expectedResult: System should block self-approval and display appropriate error message

taskDescription: Verify entries in Pending Approval state are locked from editing
acceptanceCriteria: Pending entries should be read-only until Checker acts
testSteps: 1. Try to edit a Pending Approval entry
expectedResult: System should prevent editing of entries in Pending Approval state

taskDescription: Verify rejected entries return to Draft state for Maker revision
acceptanceCriteria: Rejected entries should be editable again
testSteps:
1. Checker rejects entry
2. Maker logs in and views entry
expectedResult: Entry should appear in Drafted tab with Checker comments; Maker should be able to edit and resubmit

taskDescription: Verify audit log is created for every Maker-Checker action
acceptanceCriteria: All governance actions should generate audit entries
testSteps:
1. Submit keyword
2. Checker approves
3. Check audit logs
expectedResult: Audit log should record: timestamp, actor, action (Submit/Approve/Reject) for each step

taskDescription: Verify Maker and Checker must be different users
acceptanceCriteria: Maker-Checker separation must be enforced
testSteps: 1. Attempt to submit and approve using same user account
expectedResult: System should enforce four-eyes governance and prevent same-user approval

taskDescription: Verify user can disable an active keyword entry via action controls
acceptanceCriteria: Disable action should be available for active entries
preconditions: Active keyword entry visible in listing
testSteps:
1. Open Active tab
2. Click Disable/Off action button for a keyword
expectedResult: Disable request should be submitted for Maker-Checker approval

taskDescription: Verify disabled keyword is no longer evaluated at next screening run
acceptanceCriteria: Deactivated keyword should cease to be applied in screening
preconditions: Keyword disabled and approved by Checker
testSteps:
1. Disable keyword entry
2. Checker approves
3. Run next screening
expectedResult: Keyword should not generate alerts after deactivation at next screening run

taskDescription: Verify hard deletion of keyword entries is not permitted
acceptanceCriteria: No permanent delete option should be available
testSteps:
1. Open keyword actions
2. Observe available options
expectedResult: No permanent delete option should exist; only logical deactivation is permitted

taskDescription: Verify disable action requires Maker-Checker approval
acceptanceCriteria: Disabling should enter Pending Approval state
testSteps:
